info.name: 📌 Novita API
info.description:
### About

"Novita AI provides 200+ Model APIs, custom deployment, GPU Instances, and Serverless GPUs."

Novita runs open models from other labs, such as DeepSeek, MiMo and GLM, through an OpenAI-compatible API, plus image, audio and video models. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Inference hosts**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Novita Account: [https://novita.ai/console](https://novita.ai/console)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `novita_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:novita_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://novita.ai/docs/api-reference/basic-authentication](https://novita.ai/docs/api-reference/basic-authentication)
    
- Models: [https://novita.ai/models-console](https://novita.ai/models-console)
